decisions.decision: Every required evidence, identity, eligibility, safety, access, protection, operational, and Stage-1 provenance gate must be PASS; UNKNOWN fails closed for issuance.
Candidate-level UNKNOWN excludes that candidate; inability to establish snapshot-level protected-bundle completeness forces route-day abstention.
Enumerate 10-combinations with ten distinct physical_location_id values and all registered joint composition/capacity constraints; ten individually admissible candidates alone are insufficient.
Version 1 uses exact additive epsilon_B=0, so proximity is a tie-break only among primary-value-maximizing lists.
Public oracle scores use scaled integers or exact rationals; binary floating point, NaN, implicit rounding, and index-based ties are forbidden.

After equal primary value and proximity, select the lexicographically smallest canonical tuple of sorted physical-location and candidate IDs; output order is canonical display order, not a claimed visit sequence.
Abstain when unresolved candidates could dominate the selected list; no global optimality claim is allowed until conservative bound semantics are registered.
Malformed or incoherent input is a validation failure; valid input with no provable feasible ten returns ABSTAIN_NO_VALID_TEN.
Public exhaustive enumeration is capped at 20 candidates and enumerates combinations, not route permutations; route sequencing requires a separate smaller contract.
A valid input with at least one provable feasible ten must ISSUE and may not always abstain.
Candidate protection tokens are intersected with the complete snapshot protected-token bundle; any match excludes the candidate even when its direct protected_status is CLEAR.

The exact primary objective subtracts registered scaled-integer pairwise redundancy and interference penalties before proximity tie-breaking; empty tables explicitly mean zero in the bounded v1 oracle.
Every observation must be at or before the Stage-1 cutoff, the cutoff must be at or before issued_at, issuance must precede the route date, and every decision echoes snapshot and policy digests.

Computed outputs bind structured evidence or authority attestations and may not exceed the weakest load-bearing input proof level; sensitivity values remain scenario-only at proof level four or below.

Version 1 decision problems are explicitly SYNTHETIC_FORMAL_ONLY and accept only REGISTERED_SYNTHETIC_PROXY scores; live issuance requires a later evidence-bound contract version and cannot use this oracle entry point.

Analysis family, sidedness, multiplicity, randomization unit, estimator, variance model, alpha, target power, and allocation are unset human-authoritative protocol inputs under GATE-EXPERIMENT-PROTOCOL-001; instrumentation inputs use the outcome-maturity gate rather than the final-evidence gate.
